meta.description:
[accent]Mindustry Survivors[]
[lightgray]Vampire Survivors in Mindustry[]


[#ff9a3c]How to play[]

Survive [accent]50 waves[] on a random map while enemies chase you from every side.

Kill them to pick up [#84f491]gems[] and level up. Each level, pick 1 of 3 random cards:
[accent]>[] new [accent]turrets[]
[accent]>[] [accent]upgrades[] for turrets you have
[accent]>[] [#5c9cff]passives[] that make you faster or tougher

There is nothing to build. Just move, aim and stay alive.


[#ff9a3c]What waits for you[]

[accent]>[] All [accent]28 turrets[] from Serpulo and Erekir, each with 10 levels
[accent]>[] [scarlet]Bosses[] every 25 waves
[accent]>[] [#b07ae8]Curses[] past Eradication for a real challenge [lightgray](experimental, not balanced yet)[]
[accent]>[] [accent]Endless[] mode after wave 50


[lightgray]Needs Mindustry v8 (build 160 or newer). Desktop only.[]
